notes: No external audit has been performed. All compliance mappings are internal and require formal review before official compliance can be claimed.

wcag_mappings.description: The <blockquote> element conveys the semantic role of a quotation. <cite> conveys attribution. <footer> contextualizes the attribution within the blockquote.
wcag_mappings.implementation: Root element is <blockquote>. Author name uses <cite>. Attribution section uses <footer>.

wcag_mappings.description: Content order in DOM reflects reading order: title → text → author attribution. Both LTR and RTL DOM order is consistent with visual presentation.
wcag_mappings.implementation: .quote__body precedes .quote__author-details in DOM order for all variants.

wcag_mappings.description: Text color tokens must meet 4.5:1 contrast against their respective backgrounds. Contrast is token-dependent and must be verified in the consuming page context.
wcag_mappings.implementation: Title: --Text-text-default (#161616) on white/neutral-50. Text: --Text-text-primary-paragraph (#384250) on white/neutral-50. Mark: --Text-text-primary-sa-flag (#14573A). Formal contrast audit pending.

wcag_mappings.description: Component is purely presentational with no interactive elements. No keyboard interaction is required. Component does not trap focus.
wcag_mappings.implementation: No interactive elements. No tabindex. No event handlers.

wcag_mappings.description: Semantic elements convey roles without explicit ARIA. <blockquote> provides quote role. <cite> provides citation semantics. No additional ARIA attributes needed for the static component.
wcag_mappings.implementation: Semantic HTML used throughout. No ARIA overrides required.

platform_code_mappings.title: Root element must be <blockquote>
platform_code_mappings.description: The .quote class must be applied to a <blockquote> element.

platform_code_mappings.title: Author name must use <cite>
platform_code_mappings.description: The .quote__author-name class must be applied to a <cite> element.

platform_code_mappings.title: All visual values must use design tokens
platform_code_mappings.description: No hardcoded hex, rgba, px, or font values in component instances. All values must be sourced from CSS custom properties.
platform_code_mappings.notes: All 24 component-level tokens are currently missing from token.css. Fallbacks use raw Figma tokens. Token addition is a pending global update.

platform_code_mappings.title: Direction must be set via dir attribute
platform_code_mappings.description: RTL/LTR layout is controlled by [dir='rtl'] CSS selectors. The dir attribute must be set on the .quote element or an ancestor, not via a modifier class.
